img.caption: Fig 3: Calibration quality. (a) Expected Calibration Error (15-bin); (b) intra-domain false-reject rate. Hatched n/a: CICC only on CLINC150. CICC/MULACONF are poorly calibrated (ECE 0.16) and refuse 59-64% of in-domain queries; on multi-intent benchmarks MULACONF ECE worsens to 0.54 and false-reaches 0.82-1.00. QP-10-shot never refuses but is miscalibrated (ECE 0.15-0.47). Ours attains the lowest ECE on CLINC150 (0.005) and MixSNIPS (0.045) while keeping false refusal within 4.6-20.8%.
